nodes.name: GreenGrocer project

nodes.name: HESTIA Data Platform

nodes.name: EXIOBASE 3

relationships.evidence: GreenGrocer states that it will strengthen HESTIA and deploy its farm sustainability toolkit to about 20,000 farms.
relationships.constraints: Future GreenGrocer outputs may not share HESTIA release/licence terms.

relationships.evidence: The project names EXIOBASE among major food-footprint databases to be strengthened and standardized.
relationships.constraints: Planned improvements are not current EXIOBASE releases.
relationships.validation_question: Create separate records for released GreenGrocer-derived versions.

relationships.evidence: GreenGrocer explicitly includes Trase in work on food supply-chain specificity and deforestation blind spots.
relationships.constraints: Trase is not a conventional process-LCI database.
relationships.validation_question: Define mappings from trade/deforestation evidence to LCI processes.
